For Petitioner(s) Mr. K.Parameshwar, AOR  Mr. Kasi Nageswara Rao, Adv.

The petitioners are accused for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 509, 506, 448, 323 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

charge sheet has already been filed as far as back in the year 2019.
